title: Kononenkogroup people
description: The studio on black: a tiny serif label and a big serif statement with an indented first line, then a ring of twelve square team photos turned to face a huge centred grotesk heading (the founding year), with two small grey notes beneath. Lines rise from their masks; the ring turns slowly with the scroll.
notes: always dark: its root carries the dark class, so it reads the theme's dark tokens even on a light page
the photos are media slots; the ring wants 8–14 of them
CSS only: the turn is scroll-driven and simply doesn't happen without support
